title: Humanly：可配置且可追溯的人机协作写作环境
summary: Humanly是一个写作平台，通过记录写作过程和AI辅助活动，生成可验证的写作证书，支持课程作业、同行评审等场景。用户研究显示其跨角色有用性，红队测试表明其打字检测器能区分人工与自动输入。
summary_en: Humanly is a writing platform that records the writing process and AI assistance to generate verifiable writing certificates, supporting scenarios like coursework and peer review. User studies show cross-role usefulness, and red-teaming tests confirm its typing detector distinguishes human from automated input.
